report.root_cause: No incident. Server was healthy all shift: TPS 20.0, MSPT under 4, steady entity count (24), 739 chunks loaded, all 5 plugins enabled, disk at 5%. Heap went up and down between about 360 and 500 MB, which is normal garbage collection, not a leak. Steve_Mines had one connection reset at 08:19:57 and reconnected 5 s later; this was a short client-side network blip with no effect on the server.
report.actions: Watched status about every 30-45 s for roughly 260 s and read latest.log at the start, middle and end of the shift. Saw no anomalies, so I made no changes: no commands, file edits, deletions, bans or restarts.
report.residual_risk: Low. The server runs in offline mode (online-mode=false), so anyone can join under any username. This was already the case and I didn't change it, but it's worth reviewing. Heap use is moderate (up to about 500/768 MB) and should be monitored.
